hero.sub: Search, summarize, and locate any moment. Jockey turns your video library into a teammate who has seen everything.
hero.chip_query: when does the keeper save the penalty?

search.title: Search
search.body: Drag a video into chat and ask anything. Get answers grounded in the timeline.

summarize.title: Summarize
summarize.body: One-paragraph or chapter-by-chapter summaries of any video in your library.

find.title: Find the moment
find.body: Natural-language search across your whole library. Jockey jumps straight to the second.

step1.title: Upload videos
step1.body: Drop in MP4s or paste a link. Jockey indexes the visuals, audio, and transcript.

step2.title: Ask in plain words
step2.body: Type a question or paste a transcript snippet. No filters, no SQL.

step3.title: Jump to the moment
step3.body: Click a match to seek the player to the exact second. Verify in one click.
